breakdown.description: Saturation temperature is inconsistent with the stated condenser pressure (10 kPa does not correspond to 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the physical inconsistency between a condenser pressure of 10 kPa and a saturation temperature of 100°C. It resolved the conflict by prioritizing the pressure value (10 kPa) and defining the condensate state as a saturated liquid at that pressure. This effectively discards the incorrect temperature, which aligns with the ground truth's primary suggestion to use the properties corresponding to 10 kPa.
